highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 collects upstream rendering corrections and safer GPU failure handling within Skia m158.
highlights_body: The unreleased update corrects filtered-image sampling and glyph cropping while preserving managed APIs, generated bindings and dependency versions.

bullets.detail: Propagates low-level draw and upload failures and abandons the context when recovery is unsafe. Failed promise-image fulfillment remains nonfatal: affected flush work is dropped, but the context remains usable.

bullets.lead: GPU allocation bounds and Imagination workarounds
bullets.detail: Checks Ganesh buffer-size arithmetic and rejects oversized MSAA attachments on affected Imagination GL, ANGLE and Vulkan devices. On Imagination Vulkan allocation errors, affected descriptor pools are deliberately abandoned rather than destroyed unsafely; Graphite rejects null pool handles.
Prevents mipmaps from incorporating unwritten scratch texels during image filtering and clips destination reads to their intended region when geometry extends beyond draw bounds.
Corrects LCD16 pixel-space bounds and source/destination cropping when glyph loads return different outlines. Bitmap dimensions, outline translation and image-buffer bounds are also checked.
Resets depth and bounds tracking after full-overwrite draws, preventing depth wrap from reordering later output.
